appendPrerequisites.headIdentityPin: tools/lib/kernel-effective-authority-chain.mjs pins the head to AUTHORITY-SUPERSESSION-03 and to the 524-byte EPOCH-03 text, its digest and its token floor; validateHead rejects a seq-4 head until those pins are amended to EPOCH-04.
appendPrerequisites.boundaryMapExtension: BOUNDARY_MAP maps only codeStart NO, runtimeCode NO and verdict NO-GO, so deriveAuthorityBoundary emits derived-boundary-unmapped for the YES/YES/GO-KERNEL-DEVELOPMENT-ONLY successor values until the YES and GO-KERNEL-DEVELOPMENT-ONLY mappings are added.
appendPrerequisites.sealedEntryDigestRegistry: SEALED_ENTRY_DIGESTS pins seq 1 and seq 2 only; seq 3 must join it when EPOCH-03 stops being the head, or the new predecessor is left unsealed.
appendPrerequisites.chainRootHeadFields: chainHeadSeq, chainHeadEntrySha256, chainSha256 and effectiveAuthorityBoundary in the chain file must all move together with the appended entry.
appendPrerequisites.consumerRestamp: Every consumer whose provenance stamp binds the EPOCH-03 boundary must be re-stamped, because stampGoverns requires the stamped boundary to equal the boundary in force.

chainBinding.note: The seq-4 entry is declared and approved here complete in sealed-entry form — every field a sealed entry carries is present and its canonical digest is correct — but that is not appendability: appendPrerequisites lists the validator and chain-root amendments an actual append still needs, none of which this record performs. The normalized text lives once, inside successorEntry, so no second copy can drift. Appending it to the append-only chain and re-stamping consumers is a Claude writer action under the Pane-visible invocation, fail-closed, with MCP claude_implement forbidden. Codex writes no repository file: it verifies, then commits, pushes and merges.

invariants: EPOCH-01, EPOCH-02 and EPOCH-03 stay byte-identical: no sealed entry, dimension or digest is rewritten by this activation.
The 691-byte GATE-01 historical approval and its digest stay immutable; historicalApprovalMutation remains FORBIDDEN.
Exactly three dimensions are superseded — codeStart, runtimeCode and verdict — under direct-user-admin-instruction authority and no others.
claudeAuthGate, deploy, gitMode, historicalApprovalMutation, platformProductWriter and release remain immovable floors.
Kernel development opens; runtime implementation has not started: runtimeImplementationStart stays NO and sdkReady, appBuildable, releaseAllowed and deployAllowed stay false.
The Claude invocation is the Pane-visible agent; MCP claude_implement stays forbidden and the per-invocation account gate stays fail-closed.

This record declares the successor entry; it does not append it. The chain head remains EPOCH-03 until a Claude writer, under the Pane-visible fail-closed invocation, appends it and re-stamps consumers; Codex writes no repository file and only verifies, commits, pushes and merges.

The successor entry is complete in sealed-entry form but is not appendable as it stands: the chain validator still pins the head to EPOCH-03 and maps only the NO/NO-GO boundary values, so the amendments in appendPrerequisites are required before any append and none of them are made here.

The bound Kernel candidate is promotion step 1 and reads BLOCKED/NO-GO with codeStart and runtimeCode false; its protocol requires this Actionplan EPOCH-04 record as step 2, so the candidate never pins its own digest and the promotion stays non-circular.
No runtime or product code is created here, and the platform product writer stays human-developer-only.
nonGoals: do not append the seq-4 entry, move the chain head, or re-derive the in-force authority boundary here
do not rewrite any sealed EPOCH-01..03 entry, dimension, digest or the historical approval
do not open sdk, app, release or deploy, and do not start runtime implementation
do not create runtime or product code in this repository

rollback.trigger: a sealed predecessor or the historical approval changes, a dimension beyond codeStart/runtimeCode/verdict is superseded, an immovable floor moves, or runtime implementation start is claimed
rollback.action: revert this activation record, the floor projection amendment, the chain validator constant, the tests and the gate wiring as one shard
